Install 48" wide x the length of track crossing humps with spring loaded flaps that will only have " wide gaps on either sides of each rail that will depress when steel wheel pass over the 48" wide access route over the tracks.

Alternatively crossings could be restricted to major traffic crossings with gates and once the gates raise that would trigger a section 48" wide traversable route that would allow only " wide gap on either sides of the tracks and no vertical transition greater than ". When the gate lowers so will the 48" wide traversable defined ADA route.

Thank you for your consideration,
If we can send men to the moon we can provide access over train tracks that will keep trains safe and provides individuals in wheelchairs opportunities to cross tracks safely.

Jean Tessmer
design@spaceoptions.com

Standing on the shoulders of Lois Thibault.
